comments.author: kokutouchichi
comments.body:
Finally someone with some creative vision! This looks sick. Love the web mechanic, is it based on setting up at least 3 points and then you can sort of automate the web after? What engine is this? Unity? Godot? Fantastic work either way.

How much was a mix of either your own assets or store assets and how much or what did the AI do for you?

replies.author: One_Low8664
replies.body: Hey, the web mechanic is indeed based on 3 points, after that the web is automated. The game was created entirely Opus 5.5. TypeScript and Three.js for spatial movement and environments, custom illustrative shaders, expressive character animation and Web Audio for responsive musical layers. All assets have been created entirely by Claude, most project was shipped by AI, it took around 4-5 prompts to get to this point. Starting a fresh project for each prompt.
